short_notes:
‣ New Grok 4.3 Model!
‣ New Audio Generation Feature!
long_notes:
Hey guys! It’s been a little while since I’ve posted an update, but I had been (slowly) working on this update for a little over a month, and I pretty much had it finished a few days ago, but then right after that I found out that xAI had just released the new Grok 4.3 model! It comes with improved reasoning and intelligence, a context history of 1 million tokens, and a December 2025 knowledge cutoff! And, to top it all off, xAI also reduced the pricing of all Grok 4.20 models to match Grok 4.3’s cost!

But anyway, enough about Grok 4.3, now to go to the second major part of this update, which is a brand new Audio Generation feature! It uses xAI’s Text-to-Speech API to generate spoken mp3 audio files, and you can either directly input the text you want spoken, or you can describe to Grok (4.1 Fast) about the audio you want to make, and it will automatically generate it for you! And it has five different voices plus the ability to clone your own custom voice via the xAI Console, and you can easily save or share the audio files, and it also lists all of the speech tags you can use in the direct input mode for easy reference!

That’s pretty much it for today, and I hope you guys all enjoy this update!
